title: open-agent-security JSON report, version 1
description: The output of `open-agent-security --json`. Keys may be added in later releases; existing keys keep their meaning while the schema stays at version 1.

rules.description: Rules that ran (rules turned off are not counted).

truncated.description: The scan stopped at the file limit.

incomplete.description: The scan could not read or check something the rules need, or stopped early. An incomplete scan never reports clean.

notes.description: What the scan skipped, could not read, or suppressed, in plain language.

suppressed.description: Findings dropped by ignore entries, inline marks or rules turned off.

config.description: The config file applied, or null.

rule.description: Rule ID, such as AP04, or a plugin's.

file.description: Path relative to the current folder when the scanned folder is inside it, else to the scanned folder; ~/ for files on this machine.

detail.description: What was found, with secrets replaced by <redacted>.

host.description: A file on this machine (--host), not in the scanned folder.

id.description: A fingerprint of rule, path in the scanned folder, redacted detail and occurrence; stable when lines move.
